sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that charge sheet has been filed against the applicant on 21.12.2020.
Thereafter he is cooperating with the trial.
Now he has apprehension of his arrest.
The applicant has no criminal history to his credit.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant.
Keeping in view the fact that applicant has not been arrested till today, when the charge sheet has been submitted on 21.12.2020, it does not appears that he has any apprehension of his arrest now.
Anticipatory bail cannot be granted on imaginary fear.
Accordingly the anticipatory bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 6.11.2023 Atul kr. sri.
